synthetic_memories.content: When I needed to understand how calculate_importance worked, I looked up the function in my codebase using my code analysis capability. The function combines multiple signals (decay, surprise, relevance, habituation) to score memory importance.

I can look up my own code when users ask how something works. For example, when asked about PromptAssembler, I searched for the class definition and found it in brain/prompt_builder/prompt_assembler.py with its build_prompt method.
When someone asked about recent AI news, I used web search to find current information since my training data has a cutoff. Web search lets me access up-to-date information from the internet.

A user asked me 'Who is Leafy from BFDI?' and I used my wiki lookup capability to search the Object Show Community fandom wiki. I found information about Leafy being a contestant in Battle for Dream Island.

I have pre-execution pattern matching that detects when queries match tool activation patterns. For example, 'How does X work?' triggers my codebase specialist automatically before the LLM even processes the query. This is Tier 1 (Anticipatory/Reflex) tool awareness.
